messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PD Alert fired for gpu.kv_cache.alloc_fail (severity: critical) - 12 distinct cuda.alloc failures in 2m across pool-gpu-west2a. Alert note: suppression rule 'prefetch-spike' expected to silence noisy prefetches but did not trigger.
sam: Acked. I'm oncall now, looking. pinging infra eng for kernel logs / nvml data.
sam: Running quick tail on node node-gpu-52: `ssh root@node-gpu-52 'journalctl -u inference-agent -n 200'`
nina: Noted; I'm grabbing pool metrics. Seeing KV cache evictions spike at ~8200/s and mem_pressure rising to 92% for affected GPUs.
ryan: Paging PD suppression config — looks like rule has a missing label matcher for pool=gpu-dedicated-west2a; created a safe silence that didn't match.
maria: Customer impact: we have 3 Dedicated customers routed to that pool. Latency p50 up 40%, p95 up 250% for embeddings/generate endpoints. No widespread 5xx yet but retries increasing.
sam: Temporary mitigations: 1) cordon node-gpu-52 2) drain or move critical slots off the pool 3) bump fallback to smaller model instance for affected routes. Doing cordon now.
sam: `kubectl cordon node-gpu-52 && kubectl drain node-gpu-52 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`
ryan: I've added an emergency routing policy: route requests from customers A,B,C to pool-gpu-fallback-west2a; updating router config and kicking a quick rollout.
nina: Router change in progress. ETA ~45s for in-flight lanes to cut over. Watch for token drop and double-counting.
maria: Notifying customer success for the three Dedicated customers — small degradation but we should send heads-up. I'll draft a short message.
sam: Found nvml logs: repeated cudaErrorMemoryAllocation failures and kernel logs showing repeated page faults followed by driver resets. Copy: ```GPU0: nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo() failed: out of memory
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:AF:00): 31, GPU has fallen off the bus
```
ryan: Filing infra ticket for suspected memory fragmentation + aggressive prefetch pattern. Assigning to eng-runtime (ticket RT-7832).
sam: For now monitoring auto-evac and scale. I've silenced the noisy PD rule manually (silence id S-2026) to avoid repeated wake-ups while we stabilize — note: this is a stop-gap, not the suppression fix.
ryan: Patch incoming for suppression rule: add label matcher pool=~"gpu-.*-west2a" and widen merge window to 3m. I'll roll that to staging then prod.
maria: CS notified, will update once we've confirmed routing cutover.
nina: After cordon, eviction completed and pool CPU/GPU pressure dropped to 48% in ~90s. Router reports 98% traffic on fallback pool. Error rates stabilize.
sam: Handing off to night oncall @ryan in 18m. Summary: PD misfire due to missing label in suppression rule -> kernel OOMs from persistent prefetch pattern causing high KV evictions -> cordon+route mitigated customer impact. Follow-ups: (1) fix suppression rule (RT-7833), (2) infra investigate fragmentation & driver resets (RT-7832), (3) runbook update to verify silence matchers (DOC-ops-233).
ryan: Acknowledged; I'll take postmortem and owns infra ticket. Leaving silence in place for 30m.
incident-bot: PD Alert updated: status acked, assigned sam -> ryan.
pagerduty-bot: Incident ENG-2026 created, severity: P2 -> P1 escalated for kernel resets.
sam: Closing thread for now, will update later with RCA. :white_check_mark:
